gates.evidence: The surface (s03, Janitor Plus paywall) is SFW and age-appropriate.
The reward is access to the '5x context' feature, which is in-app and non-transferable; no cash or clicks are incentivized.
The offer copy is gain-framed and does not use dark patterns like confirming-shaming.
The proposal states: 'The rewarded game auto-plays full-screen mid-response', which is an forced action, not an explicit opt-in.
The offer clearly states: 'Play a 15-second game to unlock 10 minutes'.
Because the game auto-plays immediately upon the trigger condition, there is no pre-ad opportunity to decline.
The proposal explicitly states: 'The rewarded game auto-plays full-screen mid-response, while the answer is still streaming'.

scores.evidence: The proposal targets the 5x context memory wall (m1/s03), which is a high-intent moment for free users, but the delivery (interruption) destroys the value.
Auto-playing an ad mid-stream violates the fundamental integrity of an AI chat app; it breaks the user's immersion and interrupts the streaming response.
The reward is highly safe: it is a 10-minute time-boxed sample (not permanent access) of a premium feature, limited to 2 per day for non-payers, with the paid plan prominently contrasted.
Cost-to-serve is $0.0018 per view, which is well below the US revenue per view ($0.0090–$0.0150).
Triggering on the memory paywall provides high reach as users frequently hit these limits.
Uses SIM-RWD as expected and maps to the existing s03 paywall.
Uses app-specific nouns like '5x context for better memory' and 'Janitor Plus'.
Includes a 2/day cap and 60-min cooldown, which is reasonable.
Includes a user-level holdout and specific KPIs like non-inferiority conversion margins.

requiredChanges: Remove the auto-play functionality immediately. Change the trigger to require an explicit user tap on an offer chip (e.g., the proposed 'Play to try' button).
Add a guardrail to ensure the trigger cannot activate while an AI response is streaming. It must wait until the response has finished generating.
Ensure the standard AdMob/Unity opt-in sequence (intro screen with 'No' option) is presented before the ad initiates.
parsed.topConcern: The auto-play trigger mid-response is a catastrophic violation of user experience, policy, and chat integrity that will immediately destroy user trust and lead to high churn.
